+    async with async_anthropic_client.messages.stream(
+        model=model,

+    assert text == "Hello."

This `get_final_text()` helper-path test verifies response model/tokens/finish reason, but it doesn't assert `gen_ai.response.id`. Since the bug being fixed is missing response-side telemetry on helper consumption, asserting the response id here would strengthen coverage.

This issue also appears on line 2209 of the same file.
